article.title: Hit the books
article.description: Meaning: to study hard, usually before an exam. Example: 'I can't go out tonight, I need to hit the books for tomorrow's test.' Register: informal, common among students. Similar idiom: 'cram for an exam' (study intensively at the last minute).
